svg.title: Itojinsei — The Iron Loom. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Magnet classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Taut Filament forks into Razor Strands then Severing Lattice, or Threadbound Vigor then Weaver Ascendant. Tangling Snare forks into Constricting Coils then Iron Cocoon, or Conductive Seam then Galvanic Marionette. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu.

Wire Blast Plus, Spiraling Wires and Lightning Threads 40), two 35% self Increase Damage Given rows (Spiraling Wires, Eternal Embrace) that compound on a hit both cover, two universal Decrease Damage Given rows (Wire Blast Plus 30%, an ally-hazard circle; Eternal Embrace 35%) and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Lightning Threads. Taut Filament answers \"How do I make my own wires cut harder: a keener strand, or a stronger hand?\": Severing Lattice adds a controlled +3 Damage to every Magnet strike with no setup window (no tier crossed), and Weaver Ascendant raises both self buffs to 43%. Tangling Snare answers \"How do I bind the target: blunt its blows, or lay it open to ours?\": Iron Cocoon takes both suppression rows +10% and Galvanic Marionette takes Lightning Threads' exposure +10%, each with a +2% rider of the other's tag. The kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, so there is no self-defensive route. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE ITOJINSEI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Magnet classification / forked tree
